Nepal Bar Council Code of Conduct 2051

Client Experiences & Professional Ethics Notice

Our professional policy regarding client testimonials, legal advertising restrictions, and confidential representation.

Regulatory Restrictions on Legal Advertising in Nepal

Under the laws of Nepal—specifically the Nepal Bar Council Act 2050 and the Nepal Bar Council Code of Conduct 2051—advocates and legal firms are strictly prohibited from commercial advertising, solicitations, or disseminating exaggerated claims of judicial success.

Our Policy on Client Confidentiality

Legal matters handled by our chambers frequently involve sensitive family disputes, corporate negotiations, or contested property titles. Out of profound respect for client privacy under the Individual Privacy Act 2075, our chambers do not publish client names, confidential settlement amounts, or identifying case details.

Principles of Client Service

  • No False Promises: We will never guarantee an acquittal, a favorable bail grant, or an assured court verdict. Judicial discretion rests exclusively with the presiding judge.
  • Procedural Rigor: We guarantee diligent research, timely pleading filing within statutory limitation (Hadmyad), and principled courtroom advocacy.
  • Fee Transparency: Retainer terms and court filing expenditures are documented in writing prior to initiating representation.

Need an Objective Legal Evaluation?

To discuss your legal matter under strict advocate-client confidentiality, schedule a consultation with our chambers counsel.
